<function name="GetAmmoData" parent="game" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the <page>Structures/AmmoData</page> for given ID.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="id" type="number">ID of the ammo type to look up the data for.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="table{AmmoData}">The <page>Structures/AmmoData</page> containing all ammo data.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
